title: 03. Keep missing, null, and zero separate

examples.explanation: Customer 1 never set a limit (default 10). Customer 2 chose no limit. Customer 3 muted alerts (0). Customer 4 chose 4. Customers 3 and 4 set a number, so `configured` is 2.
Two customers both chose 2. Count customers, not different values.

hints: Use key membership to detect absence.
Use is not None to count configured values.
